name: curate
description: Curation planner (workflow plane): make raw data standardized, self-describing and safe to move. raw-to-bids converts DICOMs to a BIDS layout via nipoppy with DataLad provenance; annotate enriches metadata (dataset_description.json, participants.json data dictionary, BIDS sidecars, controlled terms); deidentify makes identifier removal a provenanced run with a recorded approach and a required residual-risk statement, rather than an untracked fixup before the record starts. All mutations are provenanced via the datalad doer.
